rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching; every instruction line names an actor and a mechanism.

The harm is real but low-probability -- the delegating prompt is one short bullet away and the file reads fast, so a student is unlikely to actually stop and hand-read transcripts. Not filing REVISE-blocking: the likely reading is thematic framing (parallel to the 'Look wider...' bullet above it, which is explicitly the student's own scope judgment, not a literal action) rather than a competing instruction, and rewording risks flattening the Rory-style aphorism ('few engineers ever read them back') doing real rhetorical work.
